subject: Request: Renewal safeguard + uplift cap exemption for Aptiva 3yr
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Renewal safeguard + uplift cap exemption for Aptiva 3yr

Hi Hannah,

We have a procurement push from Aptiva for a 36-month commitment. They want a firm price lock on year 1 & 2, plus a maximum uplift cap of +6% on year 3. Their legal team also asks for a renewal protection clause that prevents any unilateral price increases during the renewal notice window.

Quick summary: 
- ARR at signature: $720k/year, billed annually (customer prefers annual).
- Request: 3-year term, price locked for first 24 months, year 3 uplift cap of 6%, and a renewal protection guaranteeing no >6% increase within the 60-day renewal notice window.
- Business ask: Customer will commit to expand seats over time; they want price predictability for procurement sign-off.

Attachments: Aptiva_Renewal_Term_Sheet_v3.pdf (term sheet with redlines from customer), Aptiva_SOW_redlines.docx (SOW redlines).

Do we have precedent to approve the uplift cap + renewal protection without exec sign-off? If not, please advise next steps — they need this in the legal packet by Friday.

Thanks,
Marissa

Subject: Re: Request: Renewal safeguard + uplift cap exemption for Aptiva 3yr

Thanks for the summary, Marissa — tagging Connor for exec approval and Markus for finance impact. A couple quick notes before escalation: 

- Need to confirm whether the uplift cap applies to list prices or effective net rates (post-discount).
- Confirm whether the price lock includes model version parity (customer asked about stability of model family).

Connor — can you weigh in on whether we can approve a capped uplift for Y3 (6%) for a 3-year committed deal at this ARR? If acceptable, legal wants explicit language they can drop into the contract; I've attached the term sheet redlines.

If you prefer, we can propose a conditional approval: price lock for years 1–2, Y3 capped at 6% only if usage growth < 40%; otherwise, escalation to standard list. That would protect us if they add seats rapidly.

Hannah

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Renewal safeguard + uplift cap exemption for Aptiva 3yr

Appreciate the context. I'm OK to approve a conditional uplift cap for Y3 capped at +6% with the following guardrails: 

- Approval conditions: 
  - Annualized committed value >= $700k (met).
  - Usage growth clause: if total token consumption increases >40% over baseline in any contract year, the uplift cap is void and we revert to standard pricing for the incremental consumption.
  - Net-rate definition: uplift cap applies to effective net rate after contractual discount, not to list.

- Renewal protection clause: we will not increase base subscription price by more than 6% in the 60 days prior to renewal notice. However, platform changes that materially change the cost of service (e.g., new regulatory requirements) can be excluded with documented justification and COO sign-off.

- Executive exceptions: This approval is valid for this deal only (DL-2026-0417). Any deviation (longer term, larger uplift cap, or guaranteed model parity beyond reasonable equivalence) requires CRO+Finance sign-off.

Markus — please confirm finance is comfortable with the conditional clause and note any billing or revenue recognition impacts. Lauren — please draft the legal language reflecting the above; include an explicit clause that references usage growth thresholds.

Connor
Connor O'Brien
Chief Revenue Officer

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@aptivatech.com>

Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: Renewal safeguard + uplift cap exemption for Aptiva 3yr

Sanjay — thanks for the quick turnaround and for sending over the redlines. Executive sign-off is complete with the following agreed points (summary for the contract packet):

1) Term & Price Lock: 36-month term. Price is locked for months 0–24 at the agreed net rate.
2) Year 3 Uplift Cap: Effective net rate in year 3 will not exceed a 6% uplift over year 2 net rate, subject to the usage-growth guardrail below.
3) Usage-Growth Guardrail: If Aptiva's total token consumption increases by more than 40% in any contract year versus baseline, the uplift cap will not apply to incremental usage; standard pricing will apply to that incremental volume.
4) Renewal Protection: Redwood will not increase the base subscription price by more than 6% within the 60-day renewal notice window. Exceptions for material cost changes require COO sign-off and written justification.
5) Scope: The uplift cap applies to subscription charges (net-rate) only. Hardware/cloud pass-throughs and one-time professional services are out of scope.

Next steps: Lauren will circulate an updated clause for Aptiva Legal to review and place in DocuSign. Please confirm acceptance by EOD Monday so legal can bundle the packet.

Attachments: Aptiva_Renewal_Term_Sheet_v3.pdf (updated with conditions).

Thanks — Hannah
